segments.title: AI agents booked 4 Uber rides
segments.say: AI agents booked just four Uber rides in Halloween week.

segments.title: Out of 320 million
segments.say: Out of about three hundred twenty million trips and orders, Uber says.

segments.title: Food orders? About 500
segments.say: Agents placed about five hundred food orders. Still tiny.

segments.title: The app is already fast
segments.say: A ride takes about fifty seconds to book. A food reorder, about ninety.

segments.title: Let AI compare, you book
segments.say: So let AI research and compare. Then tap book yourself.

segments.title: COMMENT BELOW
segments.say: Would you let AI book your ride? Comment below, and follow Nexora.
